detail.longDescription: # SelfHost # Docker # PiHole # Unbound OK, I think I'm going to like this setup better than before. Oldest: Unbound on two devices that blocked most common ads. Route queried in strict order and defaulted to cloudflare if both were down. Old: PiHole on Server 1. Resolving to unbound within the image and a 2ndary unbound on Server 2. Router queries strict order: PiHole, Server 2, Cloudflare. New: Pihole on Server 1 with unbound. Pihole on Server 2 with unbound. No strict order. No cloudflare.
